state: Sellers drive price lower and breach the latest confirmed low, keeping the downside active despite lingering internal chop.
paragraphs: Sellers hold the immediate advantage, pressing price down to 7653.0 and breaching the latest confirmed low at 7673.0. Confirmed swing structure remains aligned downward in a sequence of lower highs and lower lows, showing that the recent decline is extending with real force. Price is riding the lower Bollinger band at 7650.1, and the SAR level sits overhead at 7726.2, maintaining downside pressure. Even so, the move is not developing in a vacuum of clean momentum. Chop and balance measures remain elevated, and counter-moves, while shorter on average, keep interrupting the decline. The market has clear downside extension, but it is operating inside a noisy background instead of a smooth, uninterrupted trend.

Broader history across the 104-brick window shows a balanced market where bullish and bearish moves share nearly equal footing. Across those 32 total runs, bullish pushes averaged 3.31 units while declines averaged 3.19. Recent behavior departs from that balanced baseline in a sharp way. Over the last 12 runs, bearish downward extensions have stretched to an average of 4.67 units, while counter-moves have contracted down to an average of 3.0 units. Dominant selling pressure is accelerating and expanding in scope, whereas counter-runs are shrinking. That shift explains why the decline has more force now than it did across the wider historical sample even though overall chop and balance measures remain elevated.

The broader setup remains mixed, but the immediate downside pressure is gaining sharper definition. Re-acceleration reads at 57.1 alongside low opposing wick pressure of 21.3, showing that sellers are meeting little meaningful rejection when they press price lower. At the same time, chop and balance measures sit at 57.8. That elevated background disorder confirms that the decline is not unfolding as a pristine trend. Instead, control is asserting itself through force and longer downside extensions instead of smooth, uninterrupted momentum. The volatility range is contracting slightly, yet price continues to hug the lower Bollinger band at 7650.1. Sellers are imposing direct control over the immediate sequence, but they are doing so within a noisy environment that still refuses to settle.

Immediate support rests right around the harmonic D completion at 7653.0 and the lower Bollinger band at 7650.1, with the X extension waiting further below at 7615.1. Overhead, the first resistance zone forms between the SAR level at 7726.2 and the middle Bollinger band at 7706.0. Beyond that immediate band, a larger trend barrier sits higher up, anchored by the falling regression line at 7766.1 and the upper Bollinger band at 7761.9. Price sits trapped beneath these overhead obstacles while hugging the lower boundary of its range. Sellers maintain control of the immediate sequence as long as those upper barriers hold, keeping any recovery attempts contained well below the broader trend ceiling.

Sellers keep pushing price downward because they face very little immediate rejection, with opposing wick pressure sitting low at 21.3. Re-acceleration reads at 57.1, showing that downside extensions maintain active force. Yet the volatility range is contracting slightly while hugging the lower Bollinger band at 7650.1. That narrowing envelope means there is still room for the decline to travel, but fresh volatility is no longer expanding behind the move. At the same time, a developing bullish Bat pattern sits right around current price at 7653.0. This pattern acts as a source of counter-pressure without providing a confirmed reversal by itself. The selloff can continue as long as overhead barriers hold, but the contracting volatility envelope and harmonic presence serve as clear points of caution.

The broader market remains unresolved because rapid switching, erratic timing, and frequent reversals continue to color the background. That disorderly state will only give way when the market shifts into something more settled, whether through a stable range or persistent directional control. The current bearish lean becomes more convincing if sellers maintain their recent progress through repeated downside extensions, steady timing, and continued structural separation below broken lows. On the other hand, that downside bias weakens if counter-moves grow longer, opposite-side pressure returns in earnest, or buyers manage to reclaim the broken swing structure at 7673.0 and the SAR level at 7726.2. Until one of those concrete shifts materializes, the downward pressure remains active without resolving the wider environment.
